name: lever reverse grip high row (plate loaded)
description: A plate-loaded machine row with an underhand grip that trains the lats and upper back while the biceps assist.
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest against the pad and grab the handles underhand.
Set your shoulders back and down.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your back at the end of the pull.
Slowly extend your arms without letting your shoulders round forward.
